2026-11-05NRCanada Revenue Agency ActAppointment of the Chair of the Board of Management of the Canada Revenue AgencyApproval of the appointment by the Minister of National Revenue of Madhuri Parikh of Victoria, British Columbia, to be interim Chair of the Board of Management of the Canada Revenue Agency, to hold office during pleasure for a term of six months or until such time as a new Chair is appointed, whichever occurs first.N/A
subject: Appointment of the Chair of the Board of Management of the Canada Revenue Agency
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of National Revenue of Madhuri Parikh of Victoria, British Columbia, to be interim Chair of the Board of Management of the Canada Revenue Agency, to hold office during pleasure for a term of six months or until such time as a new Chair is appointed, whichever occurs first.
